title: No certificate date on the form; a compliance service is orange
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. ↳ Turn on "Is this a compliance inspection?" so the compliance block shows.
  6. Save the compliance service on a schedule and enrol an asset that has no matching certificate record.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the compliance service form for any certificate date field.
  2. On the enrolled asset, read the compliance service colour and its state with no record.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No certificate date appears on the Settings form (certificate dates belong to the record on the asset, S8).
  • A compliance service is orange, never red.
  • A compliance service with no matching record on the asset cannot come due, reads "No record", and is excluded from every count.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10560 (S3, Add a compliance inspection service); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S3; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R10: “A compliance service will be orange, never red”
  • S3-N2: “A compliance service with no matching record on the asset cannot come due, reads No record, and is excluded from every count”
